_comment: The Grade 4 English standalone lesson build - the same builder as Grades 1-3 (../grade-1-app/build-lessons.py --app .), pointed at english/grade-4/data by this file. Order here IS the unit number and the course's unit number, so u01..u10 are unit completions. strandRoles as Grades 2 and 3: spelling -> the sounds step, joining -> the everyday-words step, topic groups -> Meet the words (a group under four words joined to its neighbour, one over fourteen split).
subject: english
_taskSteps: The unit's writing and speaking tasks as two steps of their own ('Write it yourself', 'Talk it through'). 'Write a sentence' and 'Say it out loud' reach 10 of 64 writing and 20 of 61 speaking tasks in this grade; the tasks authored to close Stage 4 objectives are among the rest. Grades 1-3 set it too (2026-09-11).
